419:t_1:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, if a super-dimensional life form suddenly appeared, I'd be startled too...」

419:t_1:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Even so, walking off the job is a bad idea, $$ギルター$$.」

419:t_1:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Regarding that matter, our boss seems to be quite, quite furious, you see.」

419:t_1:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-what should I do!? Tell me, $$サルディアス$$...!」

419:t_1:10.en:
$$ギルター$$
「No! Please tell me, $$サルディアス$$!」

419:t_1:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... With your failures so far too, however I look at it, it adds up to a full-point loss, and I don't think there's room for a comeback...」

419:t_1:12.en:
$$ギルター$$
「P-please, somehow...! I don't want to fall to $$アンタレス$$!」

419:t_1:15.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If you're that determined, I'll lend you something special. Depending on how you use it, it should unleash tremendous power.」

419:t_1:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Use this to bury $c, and the boss might forgive you.」

419:t_1:17.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Thank you! Thank you so much, $$サルディアス$$!」

419:t_1:18.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Now then, $$ギルター$$... I wonder if you can handle it?)

419:t_1:27.en:
$n
「Are you interested in Jeet Kune Do?」

419:t_1:28.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ベローズ$$ told me to train my body.」

419:t_1:29.en:
$n
「I agree. If you're going to live in the fleet, your work will mostly be physical labor in your case.」

419:t_1:30.en:
$n
「If you're thinking of going back to the fleet someday, build up your body starting now.」

419:t_1:32.en:
$n
「Looks like you got a little more tanned.」

419:t_1:33.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ベベル$$ said so too, but it's from helping with the fishing these past few days. It made me keenly aware of how little stamina I have.」

419:t_1:34.en:
$n
「Until the intake procedures for the $$クーゲル$$ Fleet and the $$ラケージ$$ Pirates are finished, we're staying with the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

419:t_1:35.en:
$n
「While you can, try out all sorts of things you might be able to do here.」

419:t_1:36.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$ recommended that to me too.」

419:t_1:37.en:
$n
「That guy... He's less a pilot support system than a complete life support system for $$レド$$...」

419:t_1:38.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm as grateful to $$チェインバー#pilot$$ as I am to $$エイミー$$.」

419:t_1:39.en:
$n
「...Hey, $$レド$$... Mind if I ask you something?」

419:t_1:41.en:
$n
「About when you decided to throw away your mission as a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$, the one you had lived for.」

419:t_1:43.en:
$n
「They're complete opposites, but both carried great weight for you. Tell me how you felt when you made your decision and overcame that.」

419:t_1:44.en:
$$レド$$
「...I've never thought about the workings of my own heart.」

419:t_1:45.en:
$$レド$$
「It's just that when the time came, I found myself naturally heading toward what I truly wanted.」

419:t_1:47.en:
$n
「Thanks, $$レド$$. Not that it's meant as payment, but want me to teach you Jeet Kune Do?」

419:t_1:51.en:
$$メール$$
「Yep. Darling says he needs you for something.」

419:t_1:52.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ランド$$ wants me? What is it?」

419:t_1:53.en:
$$メール$$
「You'll find out when you get there. Now... let's la go!」

419:t_1:56.en:
$$ティティ$$
「$$ランド$$ and $$ピニオン$$ are going to train $$レド$$, apparently.」

419:t_1:59.en:
$n
「I'm one of the people $$ランド$$ trained too, you know.」

419:t_1:60.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So that's why you have such a nice smile, $n.」

419:t_1:64.en:
$n
(I guess I'd better not ask about family after all... Everyone has their own circumstances...)

419:t_1:65.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Starting a conversation yourself and then leaving me hanging like that... I don't like it.」

419:t_1:67.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then I'll ask you something hard to answer instead.」

419:t_1:69.en:
$n
「She's my partner. She was also my teacher back when I went to school, so that's what I call her.」

419:t_1:70.en:
$$ティティ$$
「That's not what I want to hear. I'm asking what kind of relationship she and you have, $n.」

419:t_1:71.en:
$n
「Relationship...? We're partners when we fight, and teacher and student the rest of the time, but...」

419:t_1:72.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I don't want to hear that kind of evasion.」

419:t_1:74.en:
$$ティティ$$
「$$甲児$$, $$カレン$$ and $$アルト$$ all say to ask you for anything beyond that...」

419:t_1:77.en:
$n
「...It's not like that. Besides, there was someone else who was that to me.」

419:t_1:78.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Where is that person now?」

419:t_1:80.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Don't tell me it just fizzled out on its own?」

419:t_1:82.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then maybe I'll... throw my hat in the ring, to be $n's girlfriend.」

419:t_1:84.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Don't be so shocked. ...Wouldn't it be fun if that happened?」

419:t_1:85.en:
$n
「...Sorry... Right now isn't a situation where I can think about things like that.」
